llm.summary: The skill's stated purpose (extracting and persisting conversation 'memories') matches what the instructions do, but it persistently writes conversation data and recommends agent-config changes without declaring those permissions in the registry — this raises privacy and configuration coherence concerns you should review before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (extract memories to topic files) align with the runtime instructions which read session history and write memory files. However, the public registry metadata did not declare the file/session permissions the SKILL.md requires (FileRead/FileWrite/FileEdit, sessions_history), creating a metadata ↔ runtime mismatch that should be clarified.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to autonomously analyze end-of-conversation content and append persistent files under memory/ (topics, MEMORY.md, heartbeat-state.json). It also recommends editing AGENTS.md to ensure automatic invocation. Proactive saving of conversation contents can capture sensitive data; the skill only partially mitigates this (a 'What NOT to Save' list) but does not require explicit user confirmation for automatic saves. The heartbeat trigger (time-based + pattern matching) increases the chance of unintended persistence.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no third-party downloads — lowest install risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or external credentials are requested. The only capabilities needed are file and session access, which are proportionate to the stated purpose — provided their scope is limited to the memory/ directory and session history only.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill writes persistent files and updates agent-related files (MEMORY.md, heartbeat-state.json) and suggests adding a line to AGENTS.md. While always:false, autonomous invocation is allowed; combined with write access, this increases the blast radius for unintended data retention. The manifest omission of explicit permissions amplifies the concern.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing: 1) Confirm which platform-level permissions will be granted (exact filesystem paths and sessions_history scope). Ensure writes are restricted to a dedicated memory/ directory, not root or home. 2) Decide whether automatic extraction on conversation end is acceptable — prefer manual triggers or require explicit user consent before saving sensitive content. 3) Ask the skill author to add the required permissions to the registry metadata (FileRead/FileWrite/FileEdit, sessions_history) and to document retention, encryption, and deletion policies for stored memories. 4) Verify the AGENTS.md modification is opt-in and review any changes the skill proposes to make to agent config. 5) Add filters to avoid saving secrets/PII (API keys, passwords) and test behavior with non-sensitive sample conversations before enabling in production.
